Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: actual TRANSPARENT WIND VFX ANIMATION SOURCE for a pixel-art game, not a concept poster.
Exactly FOUR columns of equal-width cells, and TWO rows, total approximately1536x1024. Eight separate VFX cels. Transparent canvas with NO labels, text, icon frames, backgrounds, checkerboard paint, ground planes, cast shadows, characters, hands, weapons, fans, enemies or arrows. Large clear gaps at every cell boundary; all shapes within their own implicit cell, at least32px clearance. Clean sharp detailed PIXEL ART clusters and selective edges, not smooth vectors, not fuzzy mist or lens flare.
Palette crisp IVORY and restrained JADE/GREEN air with tiny pale-blue highlights, dark desaturated jade contour sparingly, upper-left highlight. WIND never ice: NO snowflakes, crystals, needles, icicles, frost, freezing, electric sparks, fire, leaves as solid objects, summoned weapons, opaque giant circles or smoke blobs.
Each row is ONE evolving four-frame sequence, left-to-right: tiny formation / expansion / controlled peak / breakup and dissipation. Four actually different intentional drawings, not translated copies. Common fixed center/origin in each cell, consistent shape scale; do not move the art around inside the cell. Negative space and separated thin wind ribbons remain abundant.
The supplied approved skill concept fixes its wind shape and choreography. Draw isolated effects ONLY. These are local melee/movement/buff visuals, not independently flying projectiles. Do not imply hitboxes, stun, pulls, invulnerability, altered reach or gameplay durations. Directional wind in these source drawings points SCREEN RIGHT. Placement/facing variants will be metadata/pixel transforms, character and VFX kept separate.
TWO rows4cells. ROW1 ONE compressed short heavy downward-forward WIND WEDGE hugs hypothetical close blade edge, gather/drive/contact/fade. Thick central stroke with tapered short ends, no detached projectile. ROW2 tight local WIND CONTACT burst, small open converging ivory-jade slivers evolving and dissipating. No shield, armor icon, enemy, defense-debuff mark, shattered fragments, lightning or ground rupture; partial penetration remains a gameplay condition, not an armor-destruction visual.
